response.overview: 4 Cameras, 3 Men, 1 City  86400 is a film that takes a 4 camera, 3 person crew through the Seaway City of Cornwall ON. The crew has 24 hours or 86400 seconds to interview atleast 24 people in 24 different locations, within the 62 square kilometers of Cornwall's boundary.  A city is defined by it's people  When you put down the city you put down the people  This is the third film from Frank Burelle and John Earle of fishrizzo productions. (Submerged 2007, Treasures of The Lost Villages 2008)
